name: Travel Time (Isochrone)
description: Travel time isochrone visualization using existing routing APIs

valhalla.purpose: Visualize travel time reachability from a point on the map (isochrone polygons)
valhalla.dataSent: Center coordinates (latitude, longitude), travel mode, contour time thresholds in minutes
valhalla.dataReceived: GeoJSON isochrone polygons showing reachable area within specified time/distance thresholds
